_comment: ADLM neutral structure example (contains no real project names, proprietary domains, or task data). Each top-level lists[] element corresponds to a list file under data/shared_lists/<listId>.json. Runtime fields like createdAt/rev/updatedAt are populated automatically by the server. This example demonstrates structural patterns: namespace suffixes, subTasks nesting, cross-list relatesTo links, exam truth triplets, and file anchors. Placeholders in angle brackets indicate where project values belong.

items.title: <Module Name> Boundary Definition & Data Contract [arch:core-arch]
items.comment:
[Scenario] State which boundary or contract this architecture task fixes.

[Conclusion / Verdict] Quantified verdict + qualifiers.

[Evidence] Reproducible command / path / hash.

[File Anchors] Primary anchor and related file list.

items.title: <Module Name>: Main Workflow Implementation [func:feature]
items.comment:
[Scenario] Task boundaries of the parent module.

[Conclusion / Verdict] Quantified verdict + qualifiers.

[Evidence] Reproducible command / path / hash.

[File Anchors] Primary anchor and related file list.

subTasks.title: <Sub-feature Name> Implementation [func:feature:<component_id>]
subTasks.comment:
[Scenario] Subtask boundaries.

[Conclusion / Verdict] Quantified verdict + qualifiers.

[Evidence] Reproducible command / path / hash.

[File Anchors] Primary anchor and related file list.

items.title: <Main Workflow> Acceptance & Regression [test:acceptance]
items.comment:
[Scenario] What this verification run confirms.

[Conclusion / Verdict] Quantified verdict + qualifiers.

[Evidence] Command output / exit code / raw server text.

[File Anchors] Primary anchor and related file list.

Note: Never redefine truth constants here; truths reside solely in exam list.

items.title: <Standard Scenario Name> Baseline [exam:scenario]
items.comment:
[Scenario] What fact this standard benchmark scenario establishes.

[Conclusion / Verdict] Quantified verdict + qualifiers.

[Evidence] Specification text / baseline file path.

[File Anchors] Primary anchor and related file list.


truth_source: <official_spec_or_evidence_path>
tolerance: <numerical_tolerance>
truth_hash: sha256:<original_evidence_sha256>

items.title: <Issue Name> Root Cause & Fix [bug:defect]
items.comment:
[Scenario] Bug symptom and reproduction conditions.

[Conclusion / Verdict] Root cause determination + qualifiers.

[Evidence] Reproduction command / log snippet / path:line.

[File Anchors] Primary anchor and related file list.

Bug items are permitted without relatesTo (orphan items are valid).
